This is the Genesis Magma GT, a mid-engined supercar from South Korea. It’s a concept, first unveiled in late 2025, but as there’s real production intent, we’ve taken a closer look at this 800hp V8. Hyundai is pushing its Genesis brand upmarket, hence the gargantuan new GV90 Neolun and its suicide doors, and the Magma GT might be its next move to rival Porsche and Ferrari!
